title: Sparse-Aware Neural Networks for Nonlinear Functionals: Mitigating the Exponential Dependence on Dimension
summary: Deep neural networks have emerged as powerful tools for learning operators defined over infinite-dimensional function spaces. However, existing theories frequently encounter difficulties related to dimensionality and limited interpretability. This work investigates how sparsity can help address these challenges in functional learning, a central ingredient in operator learning. We propose a framework that employs convolutional architectures to extract sparse features from a finite number of samples, together with deep fully connected networks to effectively approximate nonlinear functionals.…
